description: Differential mechanism across NuRD chromatinopathies: ClinVar P/LP variant-class spectrum and gnomAD constraint for GATAD2B vs CHD3 vs CHD4; plus MONDO cross-references and GATAD2B structural variants
code:
import requests, time, re, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"

def clinvar(gene, retmax=4000):
    ids=requests.get(E+"esearch.fcgi",params=dict(db="clinvar",term=f"{gene}[gene]",
         retmax=retmax,retmode="json"),timeout=120).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
    recs=[]
    for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
        j=requests.get(E+"esummary.fcgi",params=dict(db="clinvar",id=",".join(ids[i:i+200]),
             retmode="json"),timeout=180).json()["result"]
        for uid in j.get("uids",[]):
            d=j[uid]
            recs.append(dict(gene=gene,title=d.get("title",""),
                 clinsig=d.get("germline_classification",{}).get("description",""),
                 vtype=d.get("obj_type","")))
        time.sleep(0.4)
    return pd.DataFrame(recs)

frames=[clinvar(g) for g in ["GATAD2B","CHD3","CHD4"]]
cv=pd.concat(frames,ignore_index=True)
print(cv.groupby("gene").size())

# classify molecular consequence from the HGVS in the title
def mclass(t):
    t=t or ""
    if re.search(r"p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+(Ter|\*)",t) or "Ter)" in t: return "nonsense"
    if "fs" in t: return "frameshift"
    if re.search(r"c\.[-\d+*_]+[+-]\d+[ACGT]>[ACGT]",t) or "splice" in t.lower(): return "splice"
    if re.search(r"p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+[A-Z][a-z]{2}\)",t): return "missense"
    if "del" in t and "p." in t and "fs" not in t: return "inframe indel"
    if "duplication" in t.lower() or "deletion" in t.lower(): return "copy number"
    if re.search(r"p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+=",t) or "synonymous" in t.lower(): return "synonymous"
    return "other"

cv["mc"]=cv.title.map(mclass)
plp=cv[cv.clinsig.str.contains("athogenic",na=False) & ~cv.clinsig.str.contains("Conflict",na=False)]
tab=plp.groupby(["gene","mc"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nP/LP molecular-consequence spectrum:\n",tab)

trunc=["nonsense","frameshift","splice"]
summ=[]
for g in ["GATAD2B","CHD3","CHD4"]:
    row=tab.loc[g] if g in tab.index else pd.Series(dtype=int)
    tr=int(sum(row.get(c,0) for c in trunc)); mi=int(row.get("missense",0))
    summ.append((g,tr,mi,tr/(tr+mi) if tr+mi else np.nan))
S=pd.DataFrame(summ,columns=["gene","truncating","missense","frac_truncating"])
print("\n",S)
# GATAD2B vs CHD4
a=S.set_index("gene")
orr,p=fisher_exact([[a.loc["GATAD2B","truncating"],a.loc["GATAD2B","missense"]],
                    [a.loc["CHD4","truncating"],a.loc["CHD4","missense"]]])
print(f"GATAD2B vs CHD4 truncating:missense  OR={orr:.1f}  p={p:.3g}")
orr3,p3=fisher_exact([[a.loc["GATAD2B","truncating"],a.loc["GATAD2B","missense"]],
                      [a.loc["CHD3","truncating"],a.loc["CHD3","missense"]]])
print(f"GATAD2B vs CHD3 truncating:missense  OR={orr3:.1f}  p={p3:.3g}")

# gnomAD constraint
Q="""query($g:String!){gene(gene_symbol:$g,reference_genome:GRCh38){gene_id
 gnomad_constraint{pli oe_lof oe_lof_upper mis_z lof_z obs_lof exp_lof obs_mis exp_mis}}}"""
con=[]
for g in ["GATAD2B","CHD3","CHD4","MBD3","MBD2","CHD8"]:
    try:
        r=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",
            json=dict(query=Q,variables={"g":g}),timeout=90).json()
        c=r["data"]["gene"]["gnomad_constraint"]
        con.append(dict(gene=g,**c))
    except Exception as ex: print(g,"fail",ex)
    time.sleep(1)
C=pd.DataFrame(con)
print("\ngnomAD constraint:\n",C[["gene","pli","oe_lof_upper","obs_lof","exp_lof","mis_z"]])

# MONDO cross-references
try:
    u="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/mondo/terms"
    r=requests.get(u,params={"iri":"http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MONDO_0014034"},timeout=60).json()
    t=r["_embedded"]["terms"][0]
    print("\nMONDO label:",t["label"])
    print("xrefs:",[x.get("database","")+":"+x.get("id","") for x in t.get("obo_xref") or []])
    print("synonyms:",t.get("synonyms"))
except Exception as ex: print("OLS fail",ex)

# GATAD2B copy-number / structural entries in ClinVar
g2=cv[cv.gene=="GATAD2B"]
cn=g2[g2.vtype.str.contains("copy number|Variation",na=False) | g2.title.str.contains("GRCh38/hg38 1q21",na=False)]
print("\nGATAD2B ClinVar obj_type counts:\n",g2.vtype.value_counts())
print("\nCNV-like titles (first 10):")
for t in g2[g2.vtype.str.contains("copy number",case=False,na=False)].title.head(10): print(" ",t)

# Figure
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
w=0.35; genes=S.gene.tolist(); x=np.arange(3)
ax.bar(x-w/2,S.truncating,w,label="truncating (nonsense/frameshift/splice)",color="#c0392b")
ax.bar(x+w/2,S.missense,w,label="missense",color="#2980b9")
for i,(tr,mi,f) in enumerate(zip(S.truncating,S.missense,S.frac_truncating)):
    ax.text(i,max(tr,mi)*1.04,f"{f*100:.0f}% truncating",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(genes); ax.set_ylabel("ClinVar pathogenic / likely pathogenic variants")
ax.set_title("Pathogenic variant class differs across NuRD genes")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[1]
C2=C.sort_values("oe_lof_upper")
ax.barh(C2.gene,C2.oe_lof_upper,color=["#c0392b" if v<0.35 else "#7f8c8d" for v in C2.oe_lof_upper])
ax.axvline(0.35,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("gnomAD LOEUF (oe_lof_upper), lower = more LoF intolerant")
ax.set_title("Loss-of-function constraint, NuRD subunits")
for i,(g,v,pl) in enumerate(zip(C2.gene,C2.oe_lof_upper,C2.pli)):
    ax.text(v+0.01,i,f"LOEUF {v:.2f}, pLI {pl:.2f}",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,max(C2.oe_lof_upper)*1.45)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
